scope: Only this new planning folder; no product, Skeleton, board, current-state or old packet writes
author: /root/m03_binding_lifecycle_packet
full_lifecycle: NOT COMPLETE; close and transfer are deferred separately
intent: Attach an authorized native view to an identity-bound M04 owner and read current immutable projection without creating another owner or mutating document state

architecture.hexagonal: Native UI → design caller adapter → M03 open/get facade → existing M04 attach/get input dependency → M04 sole owner → existing S1
architecture.dependency: M03 facade depends on opaque M04 handle contract only. Native sender identity enters through trusted adapter. No UI filesystem or S1 access.

modules.M01: Trusted native project/document binding evidence; no identity minted from document_reference

architecture.state_ownership: M04 alone owns exactly one S1 session per trusted document. Fixture observation store is a test double, not a proposed runtime registry. M03 stores only derived attachment handle/instance/generation.
architecture.mutation: Open creates derived view attachment only; get reads. Content, history, revision and dirty baselines unchanged. No S1 construction or direct ownership adoption.
architecture.transaction: Authenticate native caller → validate closed request → resolve trusted reference and identity → M04 attach/get observation → verify observation context → deliver current projection only. No partial facade attachment on failure. No formal IO/ACK/material pin or root transfer.
architecture.system_context: Local main/editor/viewer windows consume an existing M04 design document; external native identity provider remains outside the M03 boundary
output_ports: Existing proposed M04 attach_document(trusted_binding) → opaque DocumentOwnerHandle
Existing proposed M04 get_projection(handle) → immutable projection; exact integration not yet accepted
driving_adapters: Native role/origin/instance checked Tauri design command adapter
driven_adapters: M04 owner integration as existing dependency; absent integration fails closed

diagrams.hexagonal: Native windows → design caller adapter → M03 input commands → derived facade → M04 input port → sole M04 S1 owner
diagrams.module_dependency: UI rendering → Tauri caller guard → M03 facade → M04 attach/get contract; M01 trusted identity supplied through owner integration. No backward M04→UI or domain→native dependency.

contract.C1: Unauthorized native sender produces zero dependency calls and no state change
contract.C2: Missing M04 owner-open integration returns DependencyNotReady(M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION); never invent document content
contract.C3: document_reference is a lookup hint against trusted binding only; cannot adopt identity, path or writer rights
contract.C4: Every returned binding/session/document/generation derives from authenticated M04 observation and trusted native instance
contract.C5: Get never returns another native instance binding; viewer can read only explicitly attached projection
contract.C6: Repeated open/get are reads/attachments, carry no request_id and promise no mutation replay/exactly-once
contract.C7: Retired instance, close, transfer, root switch or restart observations fence old bindings; pending old replies cannot install newer UI state
contract.C8: Unsupported/missing Form projection stays raw and inert with can_edit=false; no C1 filtering/stamping
contract.C9: No content/history/baseline/revision mutation, no candidate creation or preview grant in open/get

permissions.origin: Only native tauri://localhost or http(s)://tauri.localhost without port; remote/dev origins rejected
permissions.instance: Injected trusted live native window nonce, never labels alone. Viewer get requires preexisting explicit attachment; viewer open denied.
permissions.adopt: M04 integration must supply already approved identity binding; no new adoption behavior authorized

lifecycle.close: DEFERRED command; fixture external observation may revoke derived binding, does not implement close
lifecycle.transfer: DEFERRED command; external M04 generation change invalidates candidates/previews and old bindings by common contract, not a facade ownership mutation
lifecycle.late_ACK: No ACK called. Late save/install results belong to their original issuer workflow; open/get cannot apply ACK, claim replay or downgrade newer UI projection.
lifecycle.replay: No request_id in either root. Unknown request_id is rejected. No durable lookup/new H2 reconciliation command added.
lifecycle.restart: Old binding MissingBinding; new open requires trusted native/current owner observations, cannot claim old mutation result

calls.M04_attach_or_get: Document-model fixture only; native integration NOT RUN

UI_schema.role: main/editor attach; viewer existing attachment read
UI_schema.controls: Existing document selection invokes open; refresh invokes get. No new controls proposed
UI_schema.validation: Closed request schema then trusted identity binding
UI_schema.loading: Preserve current display with loading marker
UI_schema.error: Preserve previous display, show safe plain text diagnostic, no blind mutation retry
UI_schema.success: Install only matching live instance/document/session/generation and nondecreasing revision
UI_schema.accessibility: Announce diagnostic and loading state; no focus steal
